name: 赤膀鴨
illustrationTaxon: Mareca strepera strepera adult male breeding, separately labelled female bill feature

similarSpecies.distinction: 繁殖羽雄鳥綠頭黃喙栗胸，翼鏡藍紫並有白邊，不是赤膀鴨白翼鏡。
繁殖羽雄鳥綠栗羽冠、白喉黑頸環及長鐮刀狀飛羽，並非素褐頭。

featureNotes: 折翼可見白色內側次級飛羽翼鏡

雌鳥喙側橙色、中央脊深色

Full page read: male flowing chestnut crest green sides, white bill-base spot/throat black collar, vermiculated chest/body, long pale-edged black secondaries drooping at rear, cream undertail sides; E Asian range; NT decreasing.
